pr_title: Add Snowflake support to SQL operator and sensor
pr_body:

issue_context.title: Add support for snowflake on the sql_sensor
issue_context.body:
**Description**

Enable the support for Snowflake on the SqlSensor.

**Use case**

Currently, the `SqlSensor` supports only the following connection types,

- google_cloud_platform
- jdbc
- mssql
- mysql
- oracle
- postgres
- presto
- sqlite
- vertica

At the moment, it doesn't have support for Snowflake. This ticket is to add support for Snowflake on the `SqlSensor`.
comments: Thanks for opening your first issue here! Be sure to follow the issue template!
Hi, I would like to pick up this issue if it is a good feature to come in.
@KumarManoj-S I assigned you. to this ticket. This change seems sensible. We should not have lists of approved classes in the code, but we should rely on interfaces.

@KumarManoj-S  note that if this works for SqlSensor there is no reason it won't work for SqlOperators
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/1d36b0303b8632fce6de78ca4e782ae26ee06fea/airflow/sensors/sql_sensor.py#L72
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/0b9bf4a285a074bbde270839a90fb53c257340be/airflow/operators/sql.py#L26
 (not sure why two different lists are needed as lists are the same and there shouldn't be a reason why sensor would work on specific db but the operators won't or vice versa)
Might worth checking that if you can address both
@eladkal Sure. That's a good point. I will check if I can address both of them.

review_comments: Would you mind adding a simple test to check that all hooks' path are valid? For example using importlib? We can try to use `airflow.utils.module_loading.import_string`
@turbaszek Added, but requires updating the MSSQL mapping to ODBC per deprecation notice. Since pymssql is deprecated, the existing hook throws an import error for the existing MSSQL mapping.
Good! In this way, you've found a bug 👌
